$comment: The typechecking baseline for the TypeScript sources — it never emits (`pnpm typecheck` is `tsc --noEmit`); the emit half lives in tsconfig.build.json. Every exactness flag that has bitten a TypeScript codebase is on from the first commit, because a strictness flag added later is set to whatever the code already happens to be. The gate scripts under scripts/ are plain .mjs checked through their own config (scripts/tsconfig.json).
